name: GAN 330 3x3 Mini - 3.3cm, Keychain - 10th Anniversary Edition
description: The GAN 330 3x3 Mini - 3.3cm, Keychain - 10th Anniversary Edition is easily the best mini speed cube keychain available today. Imagine taking a shrink ray to a 356 XS, and this is your end result (excluding the GES and magnets). This tiny speedcube still features the signature GAN honeycomb design, showing just how much attention to detail went into this mini GAN cube.
